Alag inputs par almost hamesha alag numbers aate hain, lekin kabhi-kabhi do inputs ka number same ho jaata hai, jise collision kehte hain. Partitioning by hash of key ke liye Chapter 6 dekho.
idempotentAisa operation jise retry karna safe hai. Agar woh ek se zyada baar run ho jaaye, toh effect wahi rehta hai jo sirf ek baar run hone par hota. Idempotence ke liye Chapter 11 dekho.
indexAisa data structure jisse tum un sabhi records ko jaldi dhoondh sakte ho jinki kisi particular field mein koi particular value ho. Tumhare database ko power karne wale data structures ke liye Chapter 3 dekho.
isolationTransactions mein, ek saath chal rahi transactions ek doosre ko kitna interfere kar sakti hain. Serializable isolation sabse strong guarantees deta hai, lekin weaker levels bhi use hote hain. Isolation ke liye Chapter 7 dekho.
joinAise records ko saath laana jinmein kuch common ho. Zyadatar ek record doosre ko refer karta hai (foreign key, document reference ya graph ke edge ke through), aur query ko woh record chahiye hota hai jiski taraf point ho raha hai. Many-to-one aur many-to-many relationships ke liye Chapter 2 dekhein, aur reduce-side joins aur grouping ke liye Chapter 10.
leaderJab data ya service kai nodes par copy hoti hai, toh leader woh ek replica hai jise changes karne ki permission hoti hai. Leader ko protocol se pick kiya ja sakta hai ya administrator choose kar sakta hai. Ise primary ya master bhi kehte hain. Leaders aur followers ke liye Chapter 5 dekho.
linearizableAise behave karna jaise system mein data ki sirf ek copy ho, jo atomic operations (woh operations jo ek saath poori tarah effect mein aate hain) se update hoti hai. Linearizability ke liye Chapter 9 dekho.
localityEk performance trick: jo data ke pieces ek hi time par chahiye hote hain, unhe ek hi jagah rakhna. Queries ke liye data locality ke liye Chapter 2 dekho.
lockAisa mechanism jo ek time par sirf ek thread, node ya transaction ko kisi cheez ko use karne deta hai. Jise bhi woh chahiye, use lock release hone tak wait karna padta hai. Two-phase locking ke liye Chapter 7 dekhein, aur leader aur lock ke liye Chapter 8.
logAppend-only file, yani records sirf end mein add hote hain. Write-ahead log storage engine ko crashes se recover karne mein help karta hai. Log-structured storage engine logs ko apne main storage format ki tarah use karta hai. Replication log leader se followers tak writes copy karta hai. Event log ek data stream ko represent kar sakta hai. B-trees ko reliable banane aur SSTables aur LSM-trees ke liye Chapter 3 dekhein, leaders aur followers ke liye Chapter 5, aur partitioned logs ke liye Chapter 11.
materializeComputation pehle se kar lena aur uska result likh kar rakh lena, taaki jab koi maange tab tab use nikaalna na pade. Aggregation, data cubes aur materialized views ke liye Chapter 3 dekhein, aur intermediate state ki materialization ke liye Chapter 10.
nodeKisi software ka ek instance jo computer par chal raha hai, aur koi task poora karne ke liye network par doosre nodes se baat karta hai.
normalizedAise structure kiya hua ki koi redundancy ya duplication na ho. Normalized database mein jab data ka koi piece badalta hai, toh tum use sirf ek jagah badalte ho. Many-to-one aur many-to-many relationships ke liye Chapter 2 dekho.
OLAPOnline analytic processing. Aisa access pattern jahan queries bahut saare records par add ya average karti hain (count, sum, average). Transaction processing ya analytics ke liye Chapter 3 dekho.
OLTPOnline transaction processing. Aisa access pattern jahan queries fast hoti hain aur kam records read ya write karti hain, jo aam taur par apni key se dhoondhe jaate hain. Transaction processing ya analytics ke liye Chapter 3 dekho.
partitioningAisa dataset ya computation jo ek machine ke liye bahut bada ho, use chhote parts mein todna aur kai machines par failana. Ise sharding bhi kehte hain. Chapter 6 dekho.
percentileValues kaise spread hain yeh batane ka tarika, yeh ginkar ki kitni values kisi threshold se upar ya neeche hain. Jaise, 95th percentile response time woh time t hai jisse kam mein us period ki 95% requests khatam ho jaati hain, aur 5% requests zyada time leti hain. Performance describe karne ke liye Chapter 1 dekho.
primary keyAisi value, aam taur par number ya string, jo ek record ko uniquely identify karti hai. Kai applications mein system record banate waqt ise khud generate karta hai, aksar sequence mein ya random, user set nahi karta. Secondary index bhi dekho.
quorumKam se kam utne nodes jinhe kisi operation par vote karna padta hai, tab jaake woh successful maana jaata hai. Reading aur writing ke liye quorums ke liye Chapter 5 dekho.
rebalanceData ya services ko ek node se doosre node par move karna, taaki load barabar baant jaaye. Partitions rebalance karne ke liye Chapter 6 dekho.
replicationSame data ki copy kai nodes (replicas) par rakhna, taaki ek node unreachable ho jaaye tab bhi data accessible rahe. Chapter 5 dekho.
schemaKisi data ke structure ka description, jismein uski fields aur unke datatypes hote hain. Tum data ki life ke alag-alag points par check kar sakte ho ki woh schema se match karta hai ya nahi, aur schema time ke saath badal bhi sakta hai. Document model mein schema flexibility ke liye Chapter 2 dekhein, aur data aur schemas time ke saath kaise badalte hain, iske liye Chapter 4.
secondary indexMain data ke saath rakha gaya ek extra data structure, jisse tum aise records efficiently search kar sakte ho jo kisi khaas tarah ki condition match karte hon. Doosre indexing structures ke liye Chapter 3 dekhein, aur partitioning aur secondary indexes ke liye Chapter 6.
serializableAisa guarantee ki agar kai transactions ek saath chalein, toh woh waise hi behave karein jaise woh kisi order mein ek-ek karke chali hon. Serializability ke liye Chapter 7 dekho.
shared-nothingAisa architecture jismein independent nodes, jinke apne CPUs, memory aur disks hote hain, ek normal network se jude hote hain. Yeh shared-memory ya shared-disk designs se alag hai. Part II ka introduction dekho.
skewIske do matlab hain. (1) Partitions par load ka uneven hona, yani kuch par bahut requests ya bahut data hota hai aur kuch par kam. Ise hot spots bhi kehte hain. Skewed workloads aur hot spots kam karne ke liye Chapter 6 dekhein, aur skew handle karne ke liye Chapter 10. (2) Timing ki ek gadbad jisse events unexpected order mein dikhte hain. Read skew aur write skew ke liye Chapter 7 dekhein, aur clock skew ke liye Chapter 8.
split brainAisi situation jahan do nodes ek saath yeh maan lete hain ki woh leader hain, jisse system ke guarantees toot sakte hain. Node outages handle karne ke liye Chapter 5 dekhein, aur truth ko majority se define karne ke liye Chapter 8.
stored procedureTransaction ki logic likhne ka ek tarika, jismein woh poori tarah database server par run hoti hai, aur transaction chalte waqt client ke saath aana-jaana nahi hota. Actual serial execution ke liye Chapter 7 dekho.
stream processAisa computation jo lagatar chalta rehta hai, events ki ek endless stream ko input leta hai aur unse kuch output derive karta hai. Chapter 11 dekho.
synchronousAsynchronous ka ulta: aage badhne se pehle kisi cheez ke complete hone ka wait karna.
system of recordAisa system jo kisi data ka main, authoritative version rakhta hai, ise source of truth bhi kehte hain. Changes pehle yahan likhe jaate hain, aur baaki datasets isi se derive hote hain. Part III ka introduction dekho.
timeoutFault detect karne ke sabse simple tarikon mein se ek: agar kuch time ke andar response nahi aaya, toh maan lo ki kuch galat hai. Lekin timeout yeh nahi bata sakta ki problem remote node mein hai ya network mein. Timeouts aur unbounded delays ke liye Chapter 8 dekho.
total orderCheezon ko compare karne ka aisa tarika, jaise timestamps, jo hamesha batata hai ki do mein se kaun bada hai aur kaun chhota. Jis ordering mein kuch cheezein compare nahi ho sakti, use partial order kehte hain. Causal order ke total order na hone ke liye Chapter 9 dekho.
transactionKai reads aur writes ko ek logical unit mein group karna, taaki error handling aur concurrency ki problems aasaan ho jaayein. Chapter 7 dekho.
two-phase commit (2PC)Ek algorithm jo yeh pakka karta hai ki kai database nodes ya toh sab ek transaction ko commit karein (save karein) ya sab abort karein (cancel karein). Atomic commit aur two-phase commit ke liye Chapter 9 dekho.
two-phase locking (2PL)Serializable isolation ke liye ek algorithm. Transaction jo bhi data read ya write karti hai, uske sab par lock leti hai, aur transaction khatam hone tak woh locks pakde rehti hai. Two-phase locking ke liye Chapter 7 dekho.
unboundedJiski koi known upper limit ya size na ho. Bounded ka ulta.

Yeh Designing Data-Intensive Applications: The Big Ideas Behind Reliable, Scalable, and Maintainable Systems ka summary hai, jo Martin Kleppmann (O’Reilly Media, 2017) ki book hai. Yeh ek independent summary hai, author ya publisher se iska koi affiliation nahi hai.
